packageRules.description: CI starts an empty Postgres and never mounts the compose volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data, so a major image bump passes CI and then refuses to boot locally. Same-major tags still update.
A major Node bump moves node:alpine in the Dockerfile. CI builds the frontend on glibc and never builds that image. Same-major Node updates still open.
CI never starts gunicorn. Production does, via entrypoint.sh.
semantic-release runs on push to main, not in pull request CI.
No CI job installs or runs whatsapp-bot.
